summary.text: Jim Schulte is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 49, who assumed office on January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Schulte is a cattle farmer and former Missouri Highway Patrol trooper who served in the Missouri Army National Guard.

paragraphs.text: Jim Schulte was born in St. Louis, Missouri, lives in New Bloomfield, and graduated from Hazelwood High School.
He served in the Missouri Army National Guard and reached the rank of State Command Sergeant Major.
Schulte earned a bachelor's degree in management from Tarkio College.
His career experience includes working as a cattle farmer, as owner and operator of Sand Spring Shooting Academy, and as a trooper with the Missouri Highway Patrol.
In the Missouri House, Schulte's listed 2023-2024 committee assignments were the Downsizing State Government, Utilities and Veterans committees.
